profile_text.body:
AeroVironment, which refers to itself as AV, describes itself as a leading manufacturer of unmanned aircraft systems, unmanned aerial vehicles, loitering munition systems, and unmanned ground vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States military, U.S. allies, and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures high-altitude pseudo-satellites.

Its advanced development group is MacCready Works, named for Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr. According to the company, engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers there design next-generation robotic systems across air, land, and sea, working under what it calls the MacCready Method: build fast, test relentlessly, deploy advantage. The company says small, multidisciplinary teams turn concepts into operational capability in months.

AeroVironment is a public company with the ticker AVAV and CIK 0001368622, headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. Its legal exposure is listed in Virginia, with 133 matters.
